parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: This is the flush button of the toilet, typically made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It activates the flushing mechanism to release water from the tank into the bowl.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly inward when pressed and returns to its original position after release.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid that covers the toilet tank, usually made of ceramic to match the rest of the toilet.
parts.Functional_description: It protects the internal flushing components and prevents debris from entering the tank.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or removed for maintenance but remains stationary during normal use.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the toilet, made of glazed ceramic for durability and hygiene.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the user, holds water, and channels waste to the drainage system.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving structure anchored to the floor.
